description: This file defines a singly linked list data structure with methods to add, remove, get elements, and compute size. It also includes an internal Node class and a utility method to find the tail of the list.

classes.name: LinkedList
classes.description: A singly linked list implementation with basic list operations.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new element to the end of the linked list.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes the first occurrence of the specified element from the list.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of elements in the list.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the element at a specified index.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Internal method to unlink a node from the list.

methods.name: tail
methods.description: Utility function to find the last node in the list.
